title: Toolbar search matches part number or description, case-insensitively, and is page-specific
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
2. A part exists whose part number you know, and another whose description contains a distinctive word.
custom_steps:
1. Find the search input in the report's own toolbar (not the application's global search bar).
2. Type part of a known part number, in the wrong letter case (for example lower case for an upper-case part number).
3. Clear it and type a distinctive word from a part's description.
4. Clear it and type a category or vendor name that matches no part number or description.
custom_expected:
1. The search input is part of the report's toolbar (page-specific), separate from the global search bar.
2. The part-number search matches despite the different letter case (case-insensitive 'contains' match).
3. The description search returns rows whose description contains the word.
4. Category and vendor names are NOT searched - use their dedicated filters instead (deliberate, to avoid false matches on common words).
